def spiral_path(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    s=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==3][0]
    ts=set((i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==2)
    return H,W,s,ts

def make_spiral(drawn_cells,H,W,seed,turn_len_seq,start_dir):
    # turn_len_seq: segments lengths in order (e.g., [2,2,4,4,6,6,...]); walk, stop when next cell is a 2 or OOB, unless segment ended naturally
    import collections
    dirs={'U':(-1,0),'D':(1,0),'L':(0,-1),'R':(0,1)}
    res=[]
    pos=seed; cur=start_dir
    segs=iter(turn_len_seq)
    while True:
        try:L=next(segs)
        except StopIteration: break
        for _ in range(L):
            ni,nj=pos[0]+dirs[cur][0],pos[1]+dirs[cur][1]
            if not(0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W): return None,'hit edge'
            if (ni,nj) in drawn_cells or (I[ni][nj]==2): break
            res.append((ni,nj)); pos=(ni,nj)
        cur={'U':'R','R':'D','D':'L','L':'U'}[cur]
    return res

    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W,seed,ts=spiral_path(I)

    res,_=make_spiral(drawn,H,W,seed,tl_seq,start)
